An anchor split around a block drops its empty half when the reconstructed half carries the text

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<a href=\"/o\"><div>Text<a href=\"/i\">Inner</a></div></a>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
